title: Warning Against Offering Injured Animals
description: Through the prophet Malachi, the Lord of hosts rebukes the priests and the people for bringing lame and sick animals as sacrifices. He would rather have the temple doors shut than have fire lit on the altar in vain. The name of the Lord is great among the nations from where the sun rises to where it sets, where pure offerings and incense are presented. But in Israel the table of the Lord is profaned. Cursed is the deceiver who has a healthy male animal in his flock but makes a vow and sacrifices a defective one—for the Lord is a great King whose name inspires fear among the nations.
